picture-cards.looks: A section heading and subheading above photo cards, three per row (two on tablets, one on phones), with the title and text laid over the lower part of each 3:2 photo; a card can be a link.
picture-cards.use: Visual topic or skill tiles with short captions.
picture-cards.avoid: Cards whose text needs more than two sentences: the text sits on the photo, so use Image Text Card Row.

fields.image: A photo; it is cropped to 3:2 with the text over its lower part, so choose one whose subject sits high.
fields.title: A few words.
fields.link: Optional page the whole card opens.
